# Sequence Labeling and Information Extraction {#sec-sequence-labeling}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- frame NER, POS, and chunking as token classification with a decoding step;
- choose a tagging scheme and decode spans correctly, including the awkward cases;
- extract structured records with an LLM under a schema and measure whether it worked;
- build a domain extractor from a couple of hundred labelled examples.

## Exercises

1. Take a BIO-tagged sentence and hand-decode the spans, including one illegal transition. What should a decoder do with it?
2. Compare span-level and token-level F1 on the same predictions. Explain why they differ and which you would report.
